findings.title: Regression tests model an UNREACHABLE window: the clean verdict stamp derives from the SAME slot whose write the test claims is 'lost', so a clean stamp (passed=True) cannot co-occur with a lost slot write in production — the test hand-seeds the stamp
findings.evidence: compliance_enforcement.py:376-386: 'review = _read_review(callback_context); if review is None: _emit_failed_review_rollup(callback_context); return None; _emit_review_telemetry(callback_context, review.value, review.review_key)'. :360-364 stamps 'passed=review.passed, parseable=True, violation_count=len(review.violations)' where review is the NON-None result of _read_review(callback_context.state[review_key]). :280-287 (_emit_failed_review_rollup) stamps 'passed=False, parseable=False'. test :472-477 hand-seeds 'live[STATE_COMPLIANCE_REVIEW_VERDICT] = {passed: True, violation_count: 0}' DIRECTLY in the attempt-1 branch, bypassing the real _read_review->passed derivation.
findings.detail: The clean stamp (passed=True) requires _read_review to return a parseable CLEAN review from the slot — i.e. the output_key WAS written — in which case the gate (reading ctx.session.state) ALSO sees it and returns, never reaching finalize. A lost write (slot empty/prior) yields a passed=False failed-rollup stamp. So the clean-stamp + lost-write combo the test models cannot occur via real telemetry; the test hand-seeds the stamp to manufacture it.
findings.recommended_fix: Keep the pop (correct hygiene). Re-scope the new comments + _multi_attempt_judge_run_node docstring to the real guarantee: 'the slot is authoritative per-attempt — a stale DIRTY review from a prior attempt can never survive into the next attempt's slot' (the comments' 'rescue a clean verdict from a lost write' narrative is unreachable). Optionally add a test that drives the REACHABLE window honestly (dirty/failed-rollup stamp on lost write) and asserts the honest fail-close path.
